Choose the starting preset and MIDI

Choose a Serum 2 preset and export a short MIDI phrase from your track. Files stay on your Macs and in memory; nothing is uploaded to an audio service. This preview accepts one note part, at a constant tempo, up to 28 seconds. It does not import sustain, pitch bends or other performance controls.

Create makes one call to your saved Sound design engineer, then renders and verifies all three ideas. Your original stays unchanged. Nothing plays automatically.

What was verified?

Each variation starts from the same preset and plays the same MIDI. Requested controls and preset reloads are checked. Measurements show changes; your listening decides whether they are useful.



Engineer input and reply


Choose your preset and MIDI to start. Sounds and the conversation are held only while this app service runs; restarting it clears the comparison. Download any preset you want to keep before closing the service. No automatic winner is chosen.
